name: MVP
summary: Ready to build the first working version. Adds a spec convention (/spec + FEAT-NNN with validated-learning + evals + failure-states fields), a stack-configured build gate (/smoke), evals discipline (/evals — Husain; v0.30 requires failure-mode categories for AI-mediated FEATs), JIT design-tokens scaffolding (/design-tokens-init — Frost / Curtis; from v0.276.0 it also writes `docs/design/COMPONENTS.md`, the component index the agent opens before creating component number two, carrying the build-the-button-then-use-it-on-the-page rule into CLAUDE.md — IDEA-091 part 1: the two most expensive AI-UI failures, pattern reinvention and billion-line drift, both begin at component two, which is this rung, while the index that prevents them shipped at V1), AI cost discipline (/ai-cost — cohort-aware budgets + per-call logger; v0.25) + cost review cadence (/cost-review reads the ledger; v0.30), the AI-first template (/ai-first-init conductor + /ai-failure-states for the five failure modes with Eval-tested fields; v0.26+v0.30 — bakes in eval + cost + schema + failure-state design from day one), the extraction discipline (/extract + extraction-loop encoding PRINCIPLE #1's UP/DOWN router via LLM-as-judge; v0.29), the deep whole-project drift audit (/drift-deep — the 1M-context 'am I fooling myself across everything' counterpart to the cheap drift hook moment; v0.37), the revalidation gate (/revalidate — the 3-line 'still relevant? still aligned? anything changed?' check before paused work re-enters build, so you never ship a zombie feature; ported UP from the dhun dogfood, v0.48), trace error-analysis (/judge-traces — Hamel/Shankar applied to your own `.boss/trace.jsonl`: read real session traces, sort failures into a binary taxonomy, route recurring modes to /boss-learn; the deliberate reader for the auto-log substrate, v0.53), the mentor board orchestrator (/consult — convene the mentors who have a stake in a cross-cutting question, get each lens in its own voice, synthesize with the disagreement kept visible and the humane override; advisory only; IDEA-022 Track 2, v0.57), the shared craft commons (/practice — capture a better way to build with AI as a shared, attributed, staleness-aware PRAC-NNN your cofounder gets too, so the team stays current on the fast-moving agentic-AI craft together instead of re-learning it; v0.78, IDEA-037 slice 4), the deploy/reachability discipline (/ship — the CD half of building: detect the stack, run a deploy-time pre-flight against the signature vibe-coded-leak surface (no client-bundled secrets; server-side authz/RLS actually on — CVE-2025-48757/MoltBook) plus the LICENCE moment (v0.205.0): `license` scaffolds as `null` because BOSS does not pick it for you, and going live is where a not-yet stops being neutral — no LICENSE reads as all-rights-reserved, so an undecided project ships as a CLOSED one by silence; asked ONCE with both costs named, a still-not-yet recorded as `undecided` so it is a decision on file rather than a blank, and never raised again, pick the cheapest reversible host, hand back the live URL + the rollback path; stack-neutral, the pre-flight is a check not a gate; v0.92, FEAT-024), the first-landing-page generator (/landing — compose BRAND.md voice/positioning + design tokens + the canvas Promises cell into an on-brand first page, humane-checked so it converts honestly (no fake urgency/confirmshaming), then hand to /ship; product-page vs demand-page = /pretotype's fake door; generates the simple on-brand case, hands off CMS/visual-editing to Framer/Carrd; v0.112, get-it-out-the-block-not-a-CRO-tool), the post-ship measurement runner (/measure — the /pretotype counterpart: pick ONE activation metric + ONE retention curve, ≤10 events, add the AI-product metrics classic analytics misses (task-completion rate, edit-rate, cost-per-successful-outcome), free/OSS/no-lock-in; humane by construction — measures graduation not engagement, says 'go talk to your users' at n<10; v0.113), the post-launch verdict AND diagnosis in one verb (/health — renders pre/at/post-PMF from Sean-Ellis-40% + retention-curve flattening + pull-vs-push, DEFAULTING to pre-PMF because premature scaling is the #1 startup killer, then — when the curve sags — rebases past the week-2-5 AI-tourist wave to the Month-3 cohort and says WHERE it dies: top=activation→/onboard, middle=engagement→product+/roadmap+/interview-the-churned, wallet=involuntary→dunning-plumbing-point-at-Stripe; voiced through the seller→operator→leader ladder; a verdict not a dashboard, 'go talk to them' at n<10; `boss craft retention`), the activation designer (/onboard — the top-of-curve fix /health routes to: derive the aha-moment from data (best-retained vs churned cohort, not a whiteboard guess), shrink time-to-value, run concierge onboarding BY HAND for the first users (Superhuman / do-things-that-don't-scale — it doubles as /interview); humane — activation = getting them to SUCCESS fast not HOOKED fast; `boss craft activation`), the what-to-build-next weigher (/roadmap — the fuller version of /spec's loud≠important check: weigh feedback vs behavior into a SMALL Shape-Up bet-list + a mandatory NO-list, Confidence=the EVID grade (Gilad's meter on BOSS's ladder), RICE-reach OFF by default, behavior outranks requests, pre-PMF the roadmap is just 'find fit'; a snapshot you use and discard, NOT a Gantt/backlog you tend; humane — serves the silent majority not whoever shouts; v0.123), the money verb (/money — reads where you are and routes — no yes yet → /interview; a real yes but no rail → the five deferrable moves (entity / ToS+privacy / payment rail = cheapest-reversible payment-link-before-billing-system / refund posture / the first price said out loud) ending in the commitment-grade EVID so the first dollar doesn't evaporate; paying customers → operating it (behavior-triggered upgrades = a moment of value not a nag, dunning for the 20-40% involuntary churn = plumbing, point at Stripe, don't build billing, the humane price-raise = raise on value with an escape clause never a stealth raise, and expansion ONLY when usage tracks the customer's success not lock-in/struggle), checking the margin underneath via /cost-review's gross-margin band + the margin-trap moment; bright line — pointers to professionals never legal/tax advice, records the EVENT not the STREAM (no MRR dashboard); the conscience shifts validate→deliver once first revenue exists; `boss craft first-dollar` + `boss craft monetization-in-practice`). /cost-review now writes a gross-margin band (cost-per-active-user vs price + Evergreen-Ratio) that answers + closes the margin-trap moment. the earn-trust-honestly runner (/trust — the AI-specific privacy/compliance load-bearing set without the SOC2 theater: a data-minimization privacy policy (what/why/how-long/how-to-delete) + ToS + retention/deletion path, a subprocessor list auto-derived from what the app actually uses (LLM provider, vector DB, observability), the config act founders skip — 'did you actually turn on the provider's training opt-out?' (an act not a promise — 'the AI did it' is not a legal defense, Air-Canada), and a public trust-page stub; explicitly DEFERS SOC2/ISO/DPIA until a NAMED enterprise deal demands them; bright line — pointers to a real lawyer never legal advice; humane — privacy as respect, data minimization as the cheapest+kindest posture; /ship's pre-flight + /money hand off here; v0.127, closes the IDEA-012 privacy backlog gap). Plus a devlog (/log), and a session-end ritual (/close + RESUME.md). the competitive field survey (/comp-eval — find who else solves this incl. the spreadsheet/agency/doing-nothing rows that actually win, with a source URL + checked-date on every claim or it is marked unverified; a LIVING set under docs/competition/ you add rivals to, never a scoreboard; v0.190.0). Design arrives HERE as of v0.189.0 (DEC-005): one `designer` owning both halves — the visual system (tokens, type, spacing, motion) and flow/state/interaction (the five-state requirement, error and empty states, accessibility) — plus /design-review before code and /ux-check after. It replaces the ui-designer/ux-designer split, which BOSS shipped to founders while running a single designer itself, and whose two descriptions had to be glossed every time they were named. AI-generated UI reliably nails the happy path and skips empty/loading/disabled/error, and that lands the first week a founder builds a screen — not at V1. Builders: tester + planner + designer (the merged visual+flow authority — moved DOWN from V1 in v0.190.0 and merged from ui-designer + ux-designer, because the token apparatus it owns already shipped at MVP: /design-tokens-init, the design-tokens-guard hook, design-tokens-loop and /landing. The two AI-UI failure modes it exists for — missing states and token drift — land in week one, not at V1; /design-review and /ux-check came down with it, while /design-library and design-drift-loop stay at V1 where a real component set exists to render and enforce). Mentors: architect + customers + money + cofounder. `mentor-capital` is the SINGLE venture coach (DEC-006, v0.189.0): model + pricing at this rung, with the raise question and the investor story becoming live at V1 as its remit WIDENS rather than two more agents arriving — it absorbed mentor-fundraising and mentor-pitch, and moved down from V1 in the first place because /money ships here and its first-price step named it as owner. `mentor-cofounder` (the founding-team relationship — coaches a TEAM on working together across skill sets, the non-tech↔eng cofounder gap, and the hard conversations; never takes a side; v0.79, IDEA-037 slice 5). Plus 8 named loops on the v0.18 primitive — spec-loop (moment #4 restraint), pretotype-loop (Savoia), design-tokens-loop (IDEA-010), cost-budget-loop (Husain-applied-to-spend; v0.25), ai-failure-state-loop (Husain failure-mode discipline applied to UX; v0.26), extraction-loop (PRINCIPLE #1's own discipline; v0.29), cost-review-loop (the cadence /ai-cost only declared; v0.30), drift-loop (work-vs-named-risk — the closest loop to why BOSS exists; predicate-gated model judgment, v0.31), and margin-trap-loop (the post-launch cost→price bridge — fires when there's a real cost ledger + a cost review but none has looked at the margin; the model judges cost-per-active-user vs your price AND the humane profit-from-struggle read on retries/regenerations; a16z/Tunguz + PRINCIPLE #6, v0.118). /pretotype and pretotype-loop moved DOWN to Quickstart in v0.271.0 (IDEA-060) — see the L0 manifest for why. Nothing is lost here: a project at MVP has L0 installed, so the union is unchanged and boss sync reports no diff. What changes is that a Quickstart founder can now test demand WITHOUT unlocking the build tools first, and /pretotype is no longer in this rung's headline — a demand test is a poor advertisement for the build unlock, which was the inversion. design-pattern-loop lands in v0.280.0 (IDEA-091 part 5): PRINCIPLE #1's UP/DOWN sort pointed at DESIGN — three or more design reviews have happened and the product has never named a pattern of its own, so it is re-deciding every time. Predicate is a count and an absence, exactly like extraction-loop and for the same stated reason (a predicate cannot see reusability; only the model can). It counts REVIEWS rather than components on purpose — the component index moves rungs at V1, so a predicate pointed at it would break on graduation, and components are not where patterns come from: a pattern is a recurring DECISION, and decisions happen in reviews. One PAT-N row in the Ours table closes it. IDEA-093 parts 1-4 land in v0.285.0, the product twin of the design ladder: the FEAT now carries `for:` resolved against `docs/personas/` (the one payload a user-story format had that the record didn't — which is why BOSS still ships no user-story template, and now says so), /ux-check OPENS the persona file instead of recommending it, /roadmap's NO-list becomes standing and append-only in docs/roadmap/NO-LIST.md with a re-open signal on every row (the bet-list stays disposable — Shape Up is right that a bet-list you tend becomes a backlog, but deleting your reasoning while keeping your conclusions is backwards), /spec step 0b READS both roadmap files plus docs/competition/ when the FEAT is the differentiator, and field-stale-loop watches the competitive field on `quiet_for` at the 90-day threshold /comp-eval itself published — that skill only ever rendered a row's age when the founder re-ran it, which is exactly what someone who forgot the file will not do. Every part is a field, a reader, or a loop on an existing predicate: no new skills, no new verbs, and the shipped skill count is unchanged. component-reuse-guard lands dormant in v0.285.0 (Ajesh: *"if it already exists, should it be leveraged again? sometimes vibe coding can go really wild — is it new, or reuse, or adjust it?"*): when a component-shaped file is written whose name has no row in docs/design/COMPONENTS.md, it hands the agent the rows it should have compared against and asks the three-way question. It closes the honest weakness the index shipped with — the index made reuse-first CHECKABLE and nothing noticed a component written without consulting it — and it carries the decision rule, because the question is hard: match on the JOB not the look; same job + different look = a variant (a prop, not a file); same job + slightly different need = widen it; different job that looks alike = genuinely new; can't tell = variant, because forking is cheap now and expensive forever while extending is slightly expensive now and free forever. Fires once per NEW component name, never on an edit to a known one. v0.286.0 completes the COMPOSITION layer inside STYLE_GUIDE.md rather than adding a sixth artifact — four named slots (type roles / rhythm / surface language / hierarchy), shipped EMPTY on purpose under the rule 'name the slot, earn the value': a ratio handed to a founder on day one is lock-in wearing a best-practice hat, and a named blank is a decision made NOTICEABLE. /design-review fills them by READING what is already built (marked `observed`, which the founder can still change, vs `declared`, which is defended) and never by handing over a form. Same release surface-gates the DEFINITION layer: /design-review and /ux-check always branched on `shape` and /design-tokens-init never did, so BOSS built a colour token cake for terminal founders and then correctly refused to review it. contrast-guard lands dormant in v0.289.0: WCAG contrast is a PURE FUNCTION of two colours — relative luminance, a published formula, no browser and no guess — so it is the only accessibility property that can be a real boundary in a tool that ships no renderer. BOSS said two contradictory things about it in shipped text (designer.md called ratios 'not checked, never a pass', true only of a RENDERED page, while /design-library carried a {{ratio}} placeholder nothing computed), and the style guide had already prescribed the right method — 'check the token pairs, not screenshots' — with the arithmetic never shipped. On a write to the tokens file it pairs every text.* against every surface.*/background.* and reports what falls under AA (4.5 body / 3.0 large), and it states its own scope every time: these are the pairs you DECLARED; text over an image, a gradient or a translucent overlay composites at runtime, needs a rendered page, and stays NOT CHECKED. IDEA-094 part 0 lands in v0.293.0 — the keeper for the EMERGENT task list. BOSS's checklist machinery was all aimed at the PLANNED list (a FEAT's acceptance criteria, written at spec time, ticked at /close); the list that actually goes missing is the one identified WHILE working, which lived only in the chat. `.claude/rules/feature-context.md` — which had ZERO writers anywhere in BOSS and told every founder that "/close will compress this" when /close had never opened it — is adopted: it gains a Found-while-building list with the three-way sort (a task stays, new scope becomes spun_to:, an open question goes to the questions block), /spec stamps the active FEAT into it, and /close actually compresses it. The keeper is a new task-hygiene conscience moment folded into the UserPromptSubmit hook that already runs — it reads the session's own TodoWrite list out of the host transcript (whose path the host hands hooks on stdin) and fires only when open items have outrun the newest durable write by ten minutes. It inherits /pause, per-moment mute and the frequency ledger, so it is turned down like anything else BOSS says. IDEA-093 part 4b lands in v0.294.0 after an adversarially-verified research pass killed 7 of 10 outside claims AND half of BOSS's own plan: no feature-by-feature matrix (the parity trap however JIT), and /spec reads a rival's `## Where it breaks` — their users' complaints — into what-wrong-looks-like, failures never features. `/comp-eval add` now sorts a new rival as in-evidence or `watch` (Dunford's phantom competitor) and offers /pretotype's would-you-switch test in the moment when the twist lands on the differentiator; the default mode reads 1-2-star reviews for `where they're weak`. /landing writes AGAINST the alternative from the field, /pretotype reads the sort. Build-time readers of docs/competition/ went from zero to three. 90 days stays: every argument to tighten it came from a vendor selling the tightening.
